rule: Each independent code reviewer score >=94 and zero must-fix; actual local runtime/evidence and no new supported security findings also required.
same_round_clarification: A supplied the originally requested individual32-check detail after its aggregate verdict. Same reviewer, source and assessment; not a new review round. Original report retained separately.

security.limitations: Read-only static review; parent runtime evidence, no independent runtime or hash/diff recomputation claimed.

consider_dispositions.title: Refresh cached request-parent state
consider_dispositions.reason: Backend content is authoritative and correctly updates the original parent state. The editor does not render or consult cached scope_parent_state for admission or pending checks; exact official scope and current canonical work remain truthful. Adding synchronization solely for an unused future display would be speculative. No current requirement or check fails.

consider_dispositions.title: Keep boolean unset distinct on first Space
consider_dispositions.reason: Unset remains None until deliberate Space; first Space selects true, second selects false, and F4 returns to unset. These are distinct typed states, not omission/default coercion. A no-op first press or changing its selected value adds a new UX policy without fixing a current defect; preserve the existing supported control semantics.
